chunks.content: Implemented OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE for a customer-facing web application.
Rotated JWT signing keys with zero downtime using a two-key overlap strategy and short access token TTLs.
Ran a lunchtime study group on the SICP textbook for six months.
Instrumented refresh-token reuse detection so a stolen token invalidates the whole family on the next call.
Ported a legacy session-cookie auth system to stateless bearer tokens across three services.
Wrote a small internal tool for parsing X.509 certificate chains during a security audit.

query: Backend engineer to harden our JWT infrastructure with signing key rotation and short-lived tokens.
notes: Four relevant chunks (0 OAuth, 1 JWT rotation, 3 refresh-token security, 4 stateless auth). Chunk 5 is adjacent security work but not the ask. Chunk 2 is a distractor. Recall@K at K=3 must necessarily be < 1.0; at K=5 or K=8 it can reach 1.0 if all four are retrieved. QUERY REDESIGN (v1.2.M2): 'JWT rotation signing keys' targets chunk 1 specifically — plainto_tsquery 'jwt' & 'rotat' & 'sign' & 'key' all appear in chunk 1. Other relevant chunks (OAuth, refresh-token, stateless) lack these exact tokens, so they can only be found by the vector arm — an intentional multi-relevant case where keyword arm finds one hit and vector arm surfaces the rest. Keyword-arm expected hit: chunk 1 only.
